value: plants touched by a rotating paper arm for 10 days averaged 5.4 cm in height against 17.31 cm for untouched controls (unpaired t-test, P < 0.0001, t = 13.85, df = 22)
method: 12 clonal plants touched on the tops by a 40 cm rotating arm fitted with a paper sheet (3.3 rpm, 10 days) compared with 12 untouched control plants; plant height measured and compared by unpaired t-test
conditions: 24 clones from one parent plant (one genotype), n = 12 touched and 12 control; growth chamber at 21 C under constant light; touch force not stated; the same paper reports other endpoints (UdTCH1 expression about twofold higher in touched plants, UdERF4 and UdTCH4 about half of control, UdZFP2 no difference; stem anatomy from two biological replicates), and this record covers only the height comparison; growth reduction under repeated touch is a physiological endpoint, no touch receptor is identified

note: Thigmomorphogenesis in Urtica dioica; evidence_kind physiological_response because the endpoint is height under a touch versus untouched comparison. Single clonal genotype. value: buckwheat grown under LED light in a phytotron chamber was more compact, with smaller leaf area, more internodes and lower main stem height than plants in a glasshouse under solar light supplemented with HPS lamps
method: experimental light contrast, bundled with growth system: 10 pots of 5 plants per treatment, LED-only phytotron chamber against glasshouse solar light plus HPS lamps; biometrics n = 10 per treatment
conditions: single cultivar 'Panda'; both systems 16 h photoperiod and the same stated temperature (25/22 C day/night) and humidity (55 to 60 percent) setpoints, with no separate measured values given; LED average 300 umol m-2 s-1 with a red-rich spectrum, glasshouse sunlight up to 1300 to 1600 umol m-2 s-1 plus 300 umol m-2 s-1 from HPS; CO2 not reported; treatment is chamber against glasshouse, so light is not isolated from other system differences; the main stem height numbers are in Table 1 (72.5 +/- 2.4 cm LED against 86.1 +/- 1.7 cm control, +/- stated as SE), not in the quoted sentence; the Methods give inconsistent HPS timing
